summary: Sultai graveyard land-copy: stock lands plus one jackpot, then let Sin print tapped token copies of the pile.

tags.name: graveyard
tags.reason: The yard is the lottery: land density plus one jackpot decides what Sin copies.

tags.name: lands
tags.reason: Half the 99 is lands, and Sin repeats its copy loop only while it keeps exiling lands.

tags.name: lands matter
tags.reason: Scapeshift, bounce lands, and unique names (Field of the Dead) are the other win axis.

tags.name: landfall
tags.reason: Field of the Dead, Scute Swarm, Aesi, and several Avoid-with-Sin cards pay off extra land drops.

tags.name: ramp
tags.reason: The list is built to hit Sin's seven mana and to flood extra lands in a turn.

tags.name: tokens
tags.reason: Sin's trigger makes tapped token copies of the exiled cards; Field of the Dead and Scute Swarm add more tokens.

tags.name: commander matters
tags.reason: Without Sin on the battlefield the copy lottery and Will of the Sultai both modes do not exist.

tags.name: big mana
tags.reason: Lotus Field, Rain of Filth, and X spells (Exsanguinate, Finale, Profane Command) spend the extra mana.

tags.name: sacrifice
tags.reason: Land-sac spells load the yard for Sin and find unique names with Scapeshift.

tags.name: self-mill
tags.reason: Hermit Druid, Loam dredge, Hedron Crab, and Hostile Negotiations stock the yard as setup.

tags.name: adventures
tags.reason: Zanarkand // Lasting Fayth is a land with an adventure, not an adventure deck.

tags.name: auras
tags.reason: Colossification is a jackpot, not an aura theme.

tags.name: dredge
tags.reason: Life from the Loam loops lands into the yard without dumping extra permanents.

tags.name: go-wide
tags.reason: Field of the Dead and Scute Swarm can swarm if the Sin lottery is slow.

tags.name: lifedrain
tags.reason: Exsanguinate and Retreat to Hagra close games but are not the main plan.

tags.name: mill
tags.reason: Mill is fuel for the yard, not how the table dies.

tags.name: reanimator
tags.reason: Portal to Phyrexia and Profane Command can steal or return creatures, but the engine is copies, not mass reanimation.

tags.name: summons
tags.reason: Summon: Titan and Summon: Leviathan are jackpots, not a Summon tribal list.

tags.name: avatars
tags.reason: Sin is an Avatar, with no avatar tribal package.

tags.name: combo
tags.reason: The land-copy loop is a single trigger, not a two-card infinite.

tags.name: hydras
tags.reason: Mossborn Hydra is a landfall beater tagged Avoid with Sin.

tags.name: insects
tags.reason: Scute Swarm makes Insects; there is no insect tribal payoff.
